text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance I almost had in my grasp
slips right past me, gone in vain.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If only I had reached out just a little further, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Such is the dreadfulness of trials.
It truly made me realize that the path of a saint is a thorny one.
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great run.
But it was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I may have failed to grasp that great brilliance,
but a faint glow still remains in these hands."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This is a beacon of light leading toward victory.
It is none other than proof that this ordeal is by no means insurmountable!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now; I am special.
I will claim victory in the next race
and seize that brilliance with my own hands this time!
choice_data_list: As expected of the saint, we're safe now.
As expected of the saint, we're safe now.
Then let's think of a more foolproof way to win.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, forgive me for causing you worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I promise to achieve a result
worthy of pure congratulations,
rather than words of comfort.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: On the name of the Saint—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have no intention of losing, but
there are no absolutes in the face of trials.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I would be deeply grateful for your assistance once more.
